prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is close, pick it up and inspect,  otherwise approach or scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <Action ID = InspectObject    /> <SubTree ID = InspectObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO PickUpObject
	ELSE
		DO InspectObject
	END
